summary: Reduce present elements from left to right with omitted-initial-value semantics distinct from explicit undefined.

target.notes: The AST lowering must pass an explicit hasInitialValue flag because omission differs from an explicit undefined. Snapshot length, locate the first present element as the accumulator when no initial value is supplied, skip holes using HasProperty, and invoke callback through JsFunction.Call with undefined thisArg and (accumulator, value, index, array).

semantics.callback_this: undefined passed through canonical call semantics
semantics.callback_callable_check: TypeError before iteration if callback is not callable

caveats: Do not model the optional initial value with a nullable C# parameter; JavaScript distinguishes argument omission from an explicit undefined value.
Aggregate-style APIs are unsafe unless sparse holes, callback argument shape, JS call semantics, and mutation during iteration are preserved.

tests.name: uses first present element when initial value is omitted
empty array without initial value throws
explicit undefined initial value is not omission
